summary: This bill removes seven listed foreign species (Arabian oryx, banteng, Eld’s deer, Grevy’s zebra, red lechwe, gaur, and swamp deer) from the Endangered Species Act’s threatened and endangered lists and prohibits listing the Bukharan markhor.

scores.thoughts: The bill contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budget allocations. It solely addresses species listings under the Endangered Species Act.
No tax provisions, rate changes, credits, or revenue measures are present in the bill text.

No provisions concerning military funding, defense policy, or armed forces.

The bill directly amends the Endangered Species Act by removing seven species from threatened/endangered lists and prohibiting listing of the Bukharan markhor. This weakens ESA protections and reduces regulatory restrictions on activities affecting these species, aligning with limiting environmental regulations.
